teacherNotes.title: Core Words
teacherNotes.content: schedule, appointment, meeting, free, busy, plan, arrange, check, available, doctor, office

elements.content: Core Active Vocabulary (10-20 items):
schedule, appointment, meeting, free, busy, plan, arrange, check, available, doctor, office
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• Are you free this afternoon? (checking availability)
• I have a meeting at two PM (stating commitment)
• Can we meet on Tuesday? (proposing day)
• Perfect, see you then! (confirming arrangement)

teacherNotes.title: Phonetic Focus
teacherNotes.content: Intonation in scheduling questions and stress in 'appointment' /əˈpɔɪnt.mənt/.

elements.content: Pronunciation Focus:
Intonation in scheduling questions and stress in 'appointment' /əˈpɔɪnt.mənt/.

teacherNotes.title: Grammar Function
teacherNotes.content: Present Simple Questions & Time Arrangements ('Are you free on Friday?', 'Let's meet at 4:00')

elements.content: Grammar System & Functional Framing:
Present Simple Questions & Time Arrangements ('Are you free on Friday?', 'Let's meet at 4:00')
Controlled Practice:
You want to confirm meeting a friend at 5:00 on Friday. What do you say?
options: Perfect, see you on Friday at 5:00!
answers: Perfect, see you on Friday at 5:00!

elements.content: Reading Script & Dialogue:

A: Hello Mark, are you free on Friday afternoon?
B: Let me check my schedule. At three PM I have a doctor's appointment, but at five PM I am free.
A: Great! Let me meet you at five o'clock at the cafe.
B: Perfect, see you on Friday!
Listening Comprehension:
Listen to a secretary organizing three appointments and fill in the schedule calendar.

elements.content: Timestamped Multi-Duration Flows:

• 60m Flow (Essential): 0-10m Warm-up & Goal; 10-25m Vocab & Chunks; 25-40m Grammar Practice; 40-55m Speaking Pair Task; 55-60m Cool-down.
• 90m Flow (Expanded): 0-10m Warm-up; 10-30m 5-step Vocab Drills; 30-50m Grammar Workshop; 50-70m Roleplay; 70-85m Writing; 85-90m Wrap-up.
• 120m Flow (Full Workshop): 0-15m Icebreaker; 15-40m Vocab Lab; 40-70m Grammar Simulation; 70-100m Group Activity; 100-115m Writing Portfolio; 115-120m Reflection.
